Game Overview

Cube Fall puts players into a adventure experience centered on guide a constantly falling cube through an endless descent, deftly maneuvering around obstacles for as long as possible. Quick reflexes and strategic movements are your allies in this addictive and simple to grasp journey. How far can you go before your path is inevitably blocked?

How to Play

Playing Cube Fall comes down to a simple loop. Guide a constantly falling cube through an endless descent, deftly maneuvering around obstacles for as long as possible. Quick reflexes and strategic movements are your allies in this addictive and simple to grasp journey. How far can you go before your path is inevitably blocked?
